scope: Extends the one-field source-bound AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE transaction to group 343 blockHandle, retargeted to one unique source BLOCK_RECORD with a complete block body. This qualifies only the selected group-343 profile; it makes no claim for other handle roles, native block-content meaning or full document support.

contract.admission: A runtime-authored AC1027 DXF contains one STANDARD MLEADERSTYLE whose existing group 343 names Paper_Space BLOCK_RECORD 0x1E, plus one unique alternate BLOCK_RECORD 0x21 named MLEADER_ALT_ARROW and a BLOCK/LINE/ENDBLK body owned by it. The caller changes only blockHandle to that source provider. Existing graph validation must resolve the target to exactly one BLOCK_RECORD and its block body.
contract.output: The transaction authenticates original raw groups against the captured typed style, admits exactly one changed group-343 field, emits its remapped handle, and inspects the output through the source BLOCK_RECORD name-to-output mapping. Fresh import verifies exactly one raw group 343 names the emitted BLOCK_RECORD, typed blockHandle resolves to that record, and the emitted record owns the complete block body.
contract.failureAndRetry: A dangling target 0x55 and a wrong-kind LTYPE target 0x30 refuse for ASCII and binary output. Each refusal preserves a pre-existing destination and the caller's invalid handle. Repairing the same caller object to BLOCK_RECORD 0x21 and retrying on the same dx_iface succeeds and passes output/readback checks.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. The ASCII/binary sources and converted outputs are generated and removed at runtime; no DWG/DXF fixtures are committed. Fixed Model_Space/Paper_Space names are covered by the shared block-symbol key normalization used in MLEADERSTYLE raw-output inspection.
contract.limits: One AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE group-343 edit profile only. This does not qualify other versions, multiple edits, other block schemas, producer variation, native block-content meaning, complete document closure, external semantic evidence or 3D support. No support claim is promoted.

controls.referenceProof: Source group 343 begins at 0x1E; the unique alternate BLOCK_RECORD is 0x21 and owns the generated block body. Exact raw group-343 output and typed readback resolve to the remapped alternate BLOCK_RECORD handle.
controls.failureAndRetry: Dangling and wrong-kind targets each refuse for both output encodings; destination bytes and caller references are preserved, and corrected retries on the same adapter succeed.

focusedSelector.summary: 1/1 MLEADERSTYLE writer-closure selector passed. Group-343 is tested separately from group-341 across four source/output encoding combinations, with exact raw and typed output/readback, an owned BLOCK/LINE/ENDBLK body, dangling and wrong-kind refusals, destination/caller preservation and corrected same-adapter retries.
